subject: What high-stakes AI teams get right (live session)
text:
Hey Vishaal, 

Teams building AI for high-stakes use cases can't iterate in production. No "move fast", no learning from live failures. They have to get data quality right before the model ships. 

That means solving for rare events, managing annotation at scale, and keeping model performance consistent in environments where drift isn't an option, before the model ever sees production. 

Mantyx are joining us on March 27th to walk through exactly how they do it in surgical AI and what that discipline looks like when applied to other high-stakes use cases such as autonomous systems, defence, and ADAS. 

As you're building similar high-stakes use cases, it will be worth the 30 minutes. 

Register here: https://bit.ly/4buNqnk - or reply and I'll send the recording afterwards. 

Best,
